how_to_supply_it: URL Inspection API, one call per URL, 2,000/day/property: write each batch to data/atlas/measurements/gsc/url-inspection-YYYY-MM-DD.json as {"rows": [...]} with url, coverageState, lastCrawlTime, googleCanonical, userCanonical, verdict.
Or export Search Console > Indexing > Pages > any row > Export, and save as data/atlas/measurements/gsc/index-coverage-YYYY-MM-DD.csv with URL and Coverage state columns.
Crawl and indexation latency need first_published per URL in reports/atlas/live-production.json; without it the dates have nothing to subtract from and the two latency columns stay UNAVAILABLE.

decision_states.SCALE: assign only on complete evidence and an agreed indexed-share bar
decision_states.HOLD: assign only on complete evidence and an agreed bar
decision_states.FIX: assign only on complete evidence and an agreed bar
decision_states.EVIDENCE_MISSING: no GSC state for any URL in this family
decision_states.EVIDENCE_PARTIAL: some URLs have a state, not all
decision_states.READY_TO_CLASSIFY: every published URL has a state; the bar is a decision, not a measurement, so this script stops here
